A higher minimum wage would lead to increased consumer spending, as low-wage workers would finally have enough money to invest in the economy, creating a ripple effect that benefits businesses and the economy as a whole. Furthermore, our party's commitment to a strong welfare state and robust social safety nets would ensure that workers who lose their jobs due to the transition to a higher minimum wage would receive support and training to help them find new employment.
